question: 15 men complete a work in 10 days. 15 women complete the same work in 12 days. If all these men and women work together, then the number of days required to complete that work is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

(15M × 10) = (15W × 12) = Total work

⇒ M / W = 6 / 5

⇒ Total work = (15 × 6 × 10) = ( 15 × 5 × 12) = 900

⇒ 900 = [(15 × 6) + (15 × 5)] × D

⇒ D = 900 / 165 = 60 / 11 = 5(5/11) days

**∴ The correct answer is 5(5/11) days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

Given:-

15 men can complete a piece of work in 10 days

15 women can complete the same work in 12 days

**Calculation:-**

LCM of 10 and 12 = 60

Let the total work = 60units

Efficiency of 15 men = 60/10 = 6 units/day

The efficiency of 15 women = 60/12 = 5 units/day

Efficiency when they both work together = 5 + 6 = 11 units/day

Time taken to complete the work when they all work together = 60/11 = 5 (5)/(11) 

**∴ The required time is taken by them to complete the work __ 5 (5)/(11) __ days.**
